team_section.source: Current source is team-data.js and local portrait assets in assets/team. Figma card assets are referenced by project direction but no Figma link or MCP payload is present in the repo snapshot.
card_design_notes: Cards use portrait, role, name, plus/minus indicator, expandable panel, summary, and optional profile link.
Group count labels like '2 people' were removed.
CSS grid uses align-items: start so opening one card does not stretch neighboring cards.
Cards should feel native to the thin-border editorial system.
team_section.interaction_model: Clicking a team card opens its panel and closes any other open card globally. The same trigger toggles the card closed if it is already active. This is an expand/collapse model, not a flip-card model.
accessibility_requirements: Links inside closed panels should not be focusable.
Keyboard users should be able to open/close cards.
Do not remove visible focus states.
do_not_do: Do not use literal 3D flip cards.
Do not open neighboring cards visually.
Do not stretch closed cards to match open card height.
Do not reintroduce people-count labels unless requested.

portfolio_section.structure: Current implementation renders filter buttons from portfolio-data.js and a grid of logo cards for the active category. The 'all' category is generated by flattening all non-all categories. Notable Exits render as separate metric cards.
logo_card_rules: Use asset when available; use text fallback only when asset is missing.
Do not crop or stretch logos.
Cards should remain clean and editorial, not overly decorative.
